From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: CAIQ intake + preferred times for a quick preflight — upload details

Hi Olivia — quick follow-up from our notes and upload plan:

1) Pre-signed S3 approach:
- We'll create a time-limited bucket scoped to Guardian and hand over pre-signed PUT URLs.
- Recommended single-object size: up to 10 GB. For very large exports we suggest chunking by day (recommended) or using multipart uploads.

2) File naming and manifest: please include a small manifest.csv in the root of the upload that lists object keys, timestamps, and the service/component that produced them. That speeds triage during the review.

3) Telemetry window: please start with a 7-day sample (we usually request 7 days first, then expand to 21 if we need more variance).

4) KMS note: Dedicated supports customer-managed keys (bring-your-own KMS/HSM). For Hosted API we document envelope encryption and Redwood-managed CMKs. We'll include a short KMS comparison doc in the final mapping.

5) Attachments & next steps: we've uploaded the preflight artifacts to the secure upload link and included a short mapping matrix for Hosted vs Dedicated. Here's the link we provisioned for Guardian: https://redwood-secure-upload.company/put/guardian-health/slot-42 (expires 2027-04-22).

If you want, we can send a short checklist that aligns with the CAIQ sections to help you map answers to evidence quickly.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Evidence Operations | Redwood Inference
